messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. If you need the precise time, you might check a reliable world clock or your device’s time settings.

New York City is Eastern Time Zone. Current time depends on DST. We can compute approximate time based on UTC. But we don't know current UTC. We could say "I don't have real-time data" or we can approximate using known time. But we can also use the function to get weather forecast, but that doesn't give time. There's no function for time. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time data. We can provide approximate time if we assume current UTC. But we don't know current UTC. We can ask for clarification. But likely we should respond that we can't provide real-time. Let's respond politely.
